tasks.title: Freeze the remediation contracts and regenerate assignments
steps: Read this audit, contract-proposals.md, the 127 requirement blocks and 116 acceptance cases. Turn the proposed seams into revision 3 authored schemas and contracts; do not weaken existing acceptance.

Reconcile the recorded revision-3 backlog in docs/roadmap.md against current code: registry version-0 lookup and self-contained schema normalization, CLI root tokens, public/internal caller declarations, service-principal bootstrap, artifact locator staging, review eligibility and internal authority checks. Preserve tested current behavior unless a coordinated migration explicitly changes it.

Freeze the Responses prepare_session/model_step split: two explicit effects with a persisted session handle, each making one physical call; specify disclosure, timeout, cost and unknown-outcome behavior for both.

Add durable worker turns, task start/readiness, worker-subject dispatch, context preparation/publication, named output slots, job ownership, reconciliation requests, verification scans, history and restore capabilities described in contract-proposals.md.

Update model.py, packages.py and authored inputs; enumerate every affected owner/caller and migration. Generate exact DTO examples for success, denial, duplicate, stale, unknown and cancellation paths.

Resolve model action routing using an explicit controller-owned route, never by inserting undeclared attempt_id into strict adapter parameters. Pin schemas for local proposals separately from provider actions.

Publish self-contained updated AGENTS.md assignments and golden JSON fixtures before any downstream writer starts. Run render and render --check; retain all old gates and add the new vertical journeys.
required_tests: Renderer passes without the RFC or network and generated files have no drift.
Each internal operation has exact callers, transaction mode, input/output schema and replay semantics; invalid authority fields are rejected.
All new fields have migration/default/version rules; old persisted tasks and operations remain inspectable.
tasks.deliverable: Revision 3 contracts, generated prompts, schema fixtures and caller matrix; serialized specification assignment.

tasks.title: Implement shared types and strict validation for the new seams
steps: Implement only the revision 3 shared DTOs/interfaces and schema primitives; preserve existing fault/result and canonicalization behavior.
Add worker-subject execution, job claim/result, context work item, output-slot binding, restore snapshot/overlay types and discriminated model decision validation.
Reject unknown fields, duplicate keys, invalid discriminator combinations and widened scopes; keep ordered transcript/proposal arrays ordered while canonicalizing declared sets.
Provide fixture-based contract tests that all package owners can reuse without importing sibling implementations.
required_tests: All P00 golden documents round-trip and canonicalize identically.
Malformed model decisions cannot smuggle arbitrary operations, identity, grants or review decisions.
Revision 2 persisted envelopes remain readable under the declared compatibility policy.
tasks.deliverable: Shared revision 3 baseline and executable schema fixtures.

tasks.title: Reconcile toolchain and dependency evidence
steps: Integration owner alone owns root go.mod/go.sum, tools.go if needed, and docs/implementation/dependencies.lock.json during this assignment.
Compare actual Go imports, pubspec.lock, Flutter/Dart metadata and adapter protocol documents with the lock; remove stale Fyne qualification claims and distinguish historical from current evidence.

Record exact existing pins and licenses. If a controlled repository runner or Serenity seam needs a new library, resolve and pin it here before downstream use; never silently download latest at runtime.
Keep unsupported provider hard caps and Serenity capabilities explicitly blocked. Record which controlled-fixture evidence and which real-service evidence are required.
Land this root change before child-package implementation begins; no root-writing lane runs concurrently with descendants.
required_tests: Module graph, Go version and Flutter lock agree with committed manifests.
CI lock validation accepts this actual source tree and rejects a changed dependency hash.
No provider capability becomes qualified merely by editing a lock entry.
tasks.deliverable: An honest dependency and capability lock; exact build commands and known prerequisites.

tasks.title: Bind worker principals and expose authenticated caller metadata
steps: Add identity.current from the authenticated actor, exposing principal kind/scope only, never a credential.
Implement the internal worker-subject resolver from P00: a controller can resolve a configured worker to its own scoped principal, but cannot choose an arbitrary human identity.
Ensure personal chiefs, child chiefs and ordinary workers can be provisioned atomically by authorized configuration/bootstrap calls with stable worker-principal bindings.
Recheck revocation on every resolution and dispatch; preserve service-principal privileges only for controller bookkeeping.
required_tests: A worker cannot obtain the owner identity or another worker's scope.
Revocation between context construction and dispatch denies the action.
Bootstrap/replay creates one chief principal; identity.current agrees over CLI, MCP and desktop.
tasks.deliverable: Worker identity and caller-discovery operations with revocation tests.

tasks.title: Route worker proposals through the common authorization boundary
steps: Implement WorkerOperator from the frozen contract as a controller-only capability; resolve worker actor through identity instead of accepting an actor JSON field.
For each proposal recheck current worker grants, bindings, installation restrictions, scope and operation allowlist before the ordinary application dispatcher runs.
Use deterministic submission identities derived from turn/proposal identity. Preserve original command IDs and result envelopes on replay, including refusals.
Support local IO outside transactions using existing Prepare/Perform/Finish; never nest network or model calls inside a database Unit.
Keep model-visible operations separate from controller internal methods and human decisions.
required_tests: A malicious proposal for grant.create, review.decide or an internal owner operation is denied unless the explicit worker-facing contract permits it; human-required decisions always refuse.
Crash after proposal commit then redeliver: one domain mutation and same command result.
Pause/revoke between proposal and admission is observed by the real dispatcher.
tasks.deliverable: A narrow authenticated proposal executor, usable by hosted and cooperative paths.

tasks.title: Resolve complete immutable worker configuration
steps: Extend snapshots to resolve the exact worker, principal binding, instructions, skill version closure, tool bindings, execution profile, connection versions and classification constraints needed by context assembly.
Implement configuration prerequisites for runnable hosted workers; a missing profile/provider/budget must yield named diagnostics and remain unready.
Ensure chief/team creation through plans provisions identities and conversations through explicit owner ports, atomically with configuration changes.
Move organization/team/project export off the query transaction into the common durable/local-IO pipeline; register both export job and artifact metadata rather than returning invented IDs.
Preserve canonical import/export exclusions and cross-installation rebinding; export may not include secrets or execution history.
required_tests: A new worker snapshot resolves all pinned dependencies, and a stale connection version blocks apply/dispatch.
Export result is readable through job.get and artifact.read and survives restart.
Organization export/import/export preserves definitions; exported credential references require explicit rebinding on another installation.
tasks.deliverable: Runnable worker snapshots, honest prerequisites and durable configuration exports.

tasks.title: Complete connection setup and adapter validation actions
steps: Define executable tool contracts for model calls, public HTTP reads, repository operations and supported memory reads using exact adapter schemas, separate from ExecutionProfile IDs.
Complete the secure-helper receipt handoff: custody a real reference, bind receipt to challenge/account/destinations/expiry and atomically apply the verified credential reference at Finish.
Generate connection.validate actions supported by the selected adapter; do not send an invented generic probe to adapters that accept only domain-specific actions.
Persist validation evidence/freshness and callback ownership, and complete the execution-side job when validation records.
Expose setup/probe prerequisites and blocked capabilities through discovery without secret bytes.
required_tests: Real helper fixture completes a challenge; wrong account, replay, expiry and changed connection refuse.
Every built-in validation action passes its adapter's strict schema and completes job.get.
Validation freshness expires and stale validation cannot activate a changed tool or connection.
tasks.deliverable: Usable setup/validation lifecycle and pinned executable tool mappings.

tasks.title: Enforce authority on planned model and tool actions
steps: Use the frozen worker-subject and context disclosure contracts to intersect installation/org/project/task/worker authority for every model call and proposal.
Validate all resolved context classifications and destinations before model dispatch, including skills, attachments, tool results and memory excerpts.
Bind exact reviews to final action bytes, connection account/version, destination, time window and repository preconditions; no broad conversational approval may stand in for review.decide.
Return actionable prerequisite/review/deny results that the hosted loop can persist and wait on without busy retry.
required_tests: Empty tool bindings allow no external tool call even if discovery lists it.
A restricted attachment prevents a public-model request before any provider call.
Content/account/head changes invalidate the earlier review and require a new exact decision.
tasks.deliverable: Policy integration for the real hosted loop, retaining deny-wins and human review.

tasks.title: Close runtime budget and reservation accounting
steps: Specify reservation ownership for root task, attempt, physical model/tool call, evaluation and responsibility cycle; avoid double-reserving the same ceiling as independent spend.
Enforce shared root/ancestor limits across parallel children and model calls; settle real provider usage once by operation/attempt identity.
Preserve unknown/advisory liabilities across report, cancellation, retry and restore; verification success is not provider cost evidence.
Expose aggregate spending, outstanding reservations and reasons a worker cannot proceed for doctor and desktop projections.
required_tests: Two competing children cannot exceed one root/ancestor budget.
Duplicate observation settlement is idempotent; lost billing leaves the reservation visible.
Many empty reasoning cycles stop at the configured aggregate bound; zero-spend bootstrap remains usable.
tasks.deliverable: Runtime accounting rules proven with competing actual owner transactions.

tasks.title: Publish named outputs and context artifacts durably
steps: Implement artifact metadata/provenance additions for output name, task/run/attempt, producing operation and source artifacts; validate scope ownership through the frozen ports.
Support the staged-to-published handoff for contexts, model text, tool results, verifier requests and verdicts using stable source identities.
Bind an output name to one published artifact digest for a reported attempt; replacement requires a new report/attempt version and never rewrites accepted checks.
Provide bounded enumerations/pins for backups and exports, integrity verification and abandoned-staging cleanup with recovery-safe retention.
required_tests: Crash between blob publish and metadata commit can replay without a duplicate artifact or orphaned result reference.
A task cannot bind a foreign artifact or replace another attempt's output.
Reported output bytes remain readable after restart; missing/corrupt bytes fail verification and backup.
tasks.deliverable: Named output/provenance registry and reusable durable publication.

tasks.title: Add durable intent delivery and complete chat queries
steps: Add controller/execution-facing ready-recipient discovery and atomic turn admission/ack fences using message ID plus recipient ID as the deduplication identity.
Do not acknowledge a worker message until an execution turn or safe-boundary injection is committed in the same unit; reading a mailbox is not processing.
Implement authorized conversation.message.list with stable paging, sender-inclusive history, current participant checks and the declared history-disclosure boundary for newly joined participants.
Expose preview/unread/read-marker projections and exact meaningful-activity ordering; routine agent coordination must not reorder human chats.
Support durable worker replies/task links/group attachments and cancellation or clarification correlation without parsing free text into authority.
required_tests: Lost ack/restart admits one turn and one reply; multiple recipients each get their own delivery.
Reopened desktop sees both previously sent and received messages without relying on window memory.
A newly joined participant cannot read earlier undisclosed history, and quiet worker chatter leaves unread/order unchanged.
tasks.deliverable: Durable message-to-turn inbox seam and complete conversation read surface.

tasks.title: Make tasks startable and unblock dependency progress
steps: Implement versioned task.start as the explicit draft-to-ready public path using existing applyTransition, preserving draft creation semantics.
Recheck prerequisites, sealed acceptance, budgets, dependencies and worker binding at start; enqueue atomically and deduplicate the current accepted task version.
Replace preknown-output-digest dependence with sealed named-output checks from P00; only digest checks for known content require an expected digest at task admission.
Record and consume verified evidence through an explicit owner port, then wake dependent tasks only after required children independently succeed.

Handle reassignment or pending-input changes for already queued tasks: invalidate/supersede old queued runs and pin the new contract rather than executing stale work; preserve cancellation/retry fences.
required_tests: Public create then start creates exactly one ready run; duplicate start/key and concurrent start behave deterministically.
A generated report whose bytes were unknown at admission can satisfy a sealed schema/presence check, but a worker assertion cannot.
Failed child, stale accepted inputs, cancellation and changed assignment prevent old queued work from starting.
tasks.deliverable: Usable task lifecycle and generated-output acceptance without weakening verification.

tasks.title: Finish effect reconciliation and durable callback ownership
steps: Persist an explicit callback route and dispatch mode outside adapter Action parameters; validate source/owner linkage so arbitrary JSON cannot select an execution callback.
Replace operation.reconcile's stalled job with a separately admitted bounded read linked to the original logical effect, exact prior attempt/provider reference and review/policy constraints.
Return a dispatch mode of reconcile only for the admitted lookup; controller must call Adapter.Reconcile, never Invoke on original mutation bytes.
Record delayed/contradictory evidence into the original effect without allowing later failure to erase earlier uncertainty or established success.
Use fair pending scans/cursors so unresolved operations cannot permanently hide new dispatchable work beyond the batch limit.
required_tests: Lost write response followed by reconcile produces one write and only authorized read calls; never a second write.
A reconciliation job reaches a real terminal/unknown disposition and duplicate callbacks do not settle twice.
More than 100 blocked operations do not starve a later ready operation.
tasks.deliverable: Executable reconciliation and explicit callback routing with crash tests.

tasks.title: Finish Responses-to-runtime integration contract
steps: Retain the existing adapter and protocol implementation. Validate runtime-created actions against zatiti.responses.action/v1 and expose fixtures using actual context artifacts/tool closure.

Split OpenAI conversation/session preparation from the model call into separately admitted, journaled single-call effects. Persist the session handle before the model call; retain unknown preparation outcome and never use an empty conversation as proof of nonexecution. P00 must add the exact prepare_session action and pinned session-reference schema.
Define normalization for text, tool_proposals, continuation, refusal, truncation and malformed output; never execute model proposals inside the adapter.
Ensure request-context and output artifacts can be published by controller and consumed under their normalized stable references.
Keep one physical call per dispatch, explicit price/cost/disclosure limits, no hidden SDK retries and unsupported guarantees visible.
Extend protocol fixture coverage for multi-turn tool results and the exact proposed runtime stop behavior.
required_tests: Action/context produced by execution is accepted by this real adapter without schema bypass.
One model tool proposal returns inert typed data; malformed/foreign source-context proposals fail.
Lost response, missing usage and truncation retain honest disposition and cost.
Call counters observe at most one HTTP request per claimed effect; crash between prepare_session and model_step does not repeat either call, and reconciliation never invents missing usage.
tasks.deliverable: Real adapter contract fixtures and output semantics for the worker loop.

tasks.title: Implement durable worker turns and automatic hosted claims
steps: Create execution-owned turns for chat, task and responsibility triggers; use unique trigger/recipient identity and persist accountable source actor, worker, scope, limits and configuration revision.
Admit queued hosted runs automatically through the same fenced claim rules as cooperative run.claim; never auto-claim cooperative runs as hosted.
Add bounded/fair pending and claim operations for controller. Claim/run generation, lease expiry, worker pause and installation pause must be durable.
Allow bounded chief conversation turns before a task exists so the chief can clarify or propose configuration; do not require a task merely to create the first task.
Persist typed waiting reasons for missing provider, clarification, review, tool completion, dependency and budget; wakes revalidate current state.
required_tests: Message to an idle chief creates one durable turn; a duplicate creates none.
Queued hosted run gets an attempt without a human calling run.claim; cooperative run stays available to its external worker.
Controller restart fences stale claims, respects pause/cancel and does not reset a root's cumulative limits.
tasks.deliverable: A durable intake/claim state machine shared by chat and task execution.

tasks.title: Build and publish the actual model context
steps: Implement context prepare/perform/commit from P00. Prepare resolves pinned configuration/task/history/tool/memory references in a read transaction; perform reads bounded artifact bytes and stages outside the Unit; commit validates pins and publishes metadata/lineage.

Build zatiti.context/v1 in exact transcript order from worker instructions, immutable skill closure, accepted task, authorized inbox, selected memory, prior outputs and tool results. Mark untrusted parts by origin.
Carry only allowed tool schemas; empty bindings yield no tools. Enforce total token/byte limits, classification and destination constraints before dispatch.

Construct exact Responses action fields schema, kind, context_artifact, max_output_tokens, tool_contract_versions and optional continuation_reference. Resolve actual Tool and Connection refs/account; remove profile-as-tool and hardcoded connection version assumptions.
Advance context every turn/step; retained contexts remain immutable and readable after source memory/config changes.
required_tests: Produced context and action pass real adapter schemas, then a controlled provider sees the intended ordered messages.
Missing instruction bytes, stale config or out-of-scope memory refuse before network IO.
A tool result appears once in the next context; previous request context bytes never change.
tasks.deliverable: Persisted model-ready context and schema-valid model effects.

tasks.title: Interpret model responses into bounded governed work
steps: Replace unconditional prepare-next-model-step behavior with the decision state machine in contract-proposals.md: reply/clarify, local proposal, external proposal, delegate, wait, complete, refused/incomplete.

Strictly validate normalized ModelOutput and source_context against the dispatched request. Admit proposals via the worker operator and deterministic turn/proposal keys; resolve current tool/connection/bindings independently of model text.

For local management operations drive existing draft/plan/apply/task/responsibility APIs under worker authority. Report missing prerequisites or exact reviews as structured pending state and human-facing messages.
For external tools prepare effects and await their observation; append published tool result and resume with a new context. Never treat accepted as confirmed success.

Publish final reply/output artifacts, record report through the trusted internal equivalent of attempt.report and stop on completion, cancellation, timeout, root/model-step bound or unresolved effect. Heartbeats extend only an eligible live lease.
required_tests: Controlled model requests organization/task creation, a HTTP read, then a final report; real domain owners receive the calls and one final reply appears.
Duplicate proposal, injection in fetched content, fabricated human approval and unauthorized connection cannot produce effects.
Final output stops model calls; accepted/unknown external effect blocks dependent work; malformed output yields a durable bounded failure.
tasks.deliverable: The missing intent-to-work interpreter and useful hosted loop.

tasks.title: Complete responsibility reasoning and event wakes
steps: Consume durable cycle results from execution containing source responsibility/version, artifacts, child task IDs and bounded next-wake decision.
Validate useful-work/no-work/wait/escalate outcomes; record cycle and arm the next wake atomically, idempotent by cycle turn identity.
Implement authenticated event/signal and reply/dependency triggers with persisted source-event cursors, not arbitrary string matching or polling every model tick.
Recheck pause/cancel, minimum reconsideration intervals, DST/misfire and aggregate limits at wake admission; cap catch-up enumeration and batch work.
Make responsibility source linkage visible on cycle tasks and schedules so desktop can show real schedule/time-zone relationships.
required_tests: First cycle creates bounded work and a second wake without manual _scheduling.cycle.record.
No-work decisions consume bounded accounted spend; duplicate event/restart does not repeat a cycle.
Pause versus due-wake and reply versus wake races admit at most the permitted work.
tasks.deliverable: An ongoing-work cycle that actually recurs and remains bounded.

tasks.title: Drive independent verification and bind real output evidence
steps: Expose pending/claim/request/record verification work separately from generic jobs, or implement the exact unified mapping frozen in P00; never leave execution_verification_jobs undiscoverable.
Resolve named output slots to published attempt artifacts and populate VerificationRequest.Outputs; seal the exact request digest before dispatch.
Invoke the trusted verifier outside all Units through the controller; record only results from that registered verifier identity/code digest, never a worker-supplied passed flag.
Publish request/verdict artifacts and hand verified evidence to tasks before its success transition. Distinguish failed checks, unavailable verifier, manual acceptance and interruption.
Make claim/record/restart idempotent and preserve unknown costs separately from a verification verdict.
required_tests: A reported task reaches succeeded via real NewVerifier and tasks evidence, without directly inserting SQL rows or calling record from a test.
Missing bytes, wrong digest, tampered acceptance/profile or failed required child prevents success.
Crash at verifier claim/result publication/record yields one verdict with the correct task/attempt binding.
tasks.deliverable: A complete report-to-independent-result path.

tasks.title: Run sealed skill evaluations to completion
steps: Implement the frozen local job executor for skill.evaluate, preserving its accepted skill/version, fixtures, posture, limits and verifier profile.
Use published fixture artifacts and real verification rather than storing pending evaluation metadata forever.
Wire terminal results back into the skills-owned evaluation row and execution job; attach observation/evidence refs so activation can use them.
Dry-run, sandbox and advisory posture must expose their actual guarantees; never advertise unavailable containment.
Deduplicate claims/results and keep cancellation, unknown effects and changed skill bytes visible.
required_tests: An imported skill's evaluation job finishes and activation consumes its real evidence.
Failing fixture blocks activation; changed skill version cannot reuse old qualification.
Restart during evaluation does not rerun an uncertain external action or invent a pass.
tasks.deliverable: Executable skill evaluation jobs and owner completion callbacks.

tasks.title: Implement controlled repository verification
steps: Implement repository_patch_applies and repository_command using the controlled runner/profile fixed by P00/P02 inside the execution root.
Checkout the pinned repository/base/tree into a fresh disposable workspace; apply only the reported patch artifact and run only accepted argv/env/check definitions.
Bound wall time, child processes, output bytes, disk and permitted network according to the declared runner capability; do not call ordinary subprocess isolation a sandbox.
Capture base/head, patch hash, runner/version, exit status and output artifacts as independent evidence; clean up only the runner's own workspace.
If a required containment guarantee is unavailable, refuse that profile with a named prerequisite and preserve the task result as unverified.
required_tests: Valid patch/check passes; nonapplying patch, failing command and wrong repository head fail independently.
Timeout terminates the owned process group and retains bounded diagnostics.
Worker-authored passing logs or a modified verifier command cannot satisfy the sealed checks.
tasks.deliverable: Engineering-task verification, with precise supported runner guarantees.

tasks.title: Complete cooperative recovery and run export jobs
steps: Make cooperative claim return a published context artifact rather than the current digest-only synthetic envelope; show advisory posture and required capabilities.
Resume waiting runs only after unknown effects/leases are resolved under explicit recovery policy; enforce cumulative root/model-step/deadline limits across replacement attempts.
Implement run.export as a durable bounded job including accepted task, contexts, attempts, effects, outputs, costs and verifier evidence with source digests.
Provide terminal job callbacks and export artifact metadata; expose recovery obligations in task/run inspection.
Verify report outputs belong to the claimed worker/attempt and current lease.
required_tests: External worker claims, checkpoints, reports and receives independently verified result through supported public operations.
Lost claim acknowledgement replays the same lease/context and stale heartbeat cannot revive it.
run.export reaches succeeded and produces readable canonical history; restart preserves uncertainty.
tasks.deliverable: Usable external-worker lifecycle and run history export.

tasks.title: Drive turns, contexts and model/tool work in the controller
steps: Extend tick with bounded fair work phases: discover worker recipients, atomically admit turns, claim hosted work, prepare/publish context, prepare effects, settle observations and resume eligible turns.
Use internal owner ports; never query another package's tables or bypass worker authority. Remove the monitoring-only ready scan as the sole stranded-task response.
Journal every physical-call boundary, publication and callback before advancing; shutdown/restart preserves already admitted work and generation fencing.
Use explicit stored route/mode from effects; provider parameters remain strict. Dispatch Invoke versus Reconcile correctly once P23 provides reconciliation work.
Publish actionable controller obligations/health for missing profiles, blocked jobs and stalled turns with scoped IDs and no secret logs.
required_tests: A real message plus controlled model reaches a reply and verified task result while no client stays open.
Crash before claim, after context publication and after provider response resumes safely without duplicate model/tool mutations.
Blocked work beyond one batch does not starve an eligible later item; pause closes admission promptly.
tasks.deliverable: The production autonomous worker driver.

tasks.title: Attach verifier, local jobs and reconciliation driver
steps: Add declared verifier/job collaborators and execute them outside Units with bounded concurrency, deadlines and explicit owner callbacks.
Drive verification pending/claim/result records; retain independent verifier identity and publish staged request/verdict bytes before domain completion.
Register supported jobs by exact owner/operation; support skill evaluation, configuration/run exports and reconciliation. Keep unknown job kinds pending with a visible requirement.
For reconciliation consume the new admitted read dispatch and call Adapter.Reconcile once; route the observation back to the original effect owner and finish the job.
Repair post-claim crash recovery with a durable claim lookup rather than phaseStranded merely because the current pending scan cannot reveal a claimed job version.
required_tests: Every registered job kind reaches its actual completion through real owners.
Crash after claim commit but before ack can inspect the exact claim and records unknown or safely resumes according to its mode.
Reconcile call counter proves one original write and bounded lookup reads; verifier cannot be replaced by a worker runner.
tasks.deliverable: Running durable jobs and independent verification in production.

tasks.title: Wire the implemented runtime and secure setup helper
steps: Import/register responses.New and remove the stale unimplemented-adapter entry; load only valid explicit profiles.
Construct trusted verifier, local job adapters and worker operator; attach every supported collaborator in superviseController instead of only Identity/Blobs.
Implement the documented installation-time helper mechanism for credential import/consent receipts using secure local IO; profile/account secrets never enter normal operation JSON or model context.
Expose startup doctor requirements when provider, price, currency, tools, helper or runner are missing. Test registrations against the operation/job catalogs.
Keep bootstrap usable with missing paid providers and make readiness diagnostics distinguish storage-only, chat-ready and task-ready.
required_tests: The production binary accepts a valid Responses profile, starts an actual controlled model turn and attaches the real verifier.
Supported jobs are registered; a catalog-supported job lacking a runner fails an assembly test.
Fresh setup through CLI/MCP helper mechanics establishes an opaque usable connection without printing secrets.
tasks.deliverable: Production wiring and a workable credential-setup entrypoint.

tasks.title: Make first-use guidance reach actual useful work
steps: Replace the current draft-only FirstTaskSequence with a truthful sequence for configure provider/budget/tool/worker, create/start task and inspect verified output.
Keep zero-spend initialization separate from paid work and expose missing setup requirements rather than requiring users to self-publish arbitrary verifier qualification evidence.
Provision trusted installed verifier profiles/evidence through the installation contract; capability evidence must reflect a real supported verifier build.
Report stalled turns, unclaimed jobs, unavailable memory/runner and outstanding liabilities in doctor/status.
Test first-task documentation as executable commands ending in a verified artifact, plus an unconfigured installation that remains honest and usable.
required_tests: Fresh installation can complete the documented controlled-fixture first task; terminal state is succeeded, not draft.
Missing provider/currency yields named actionable requirements and no spend.
Untrusted/self-published verifier evidence does not manufacture installed capability qualification.
tasks.deliverable: First-use diagnostics and a first-task recipe that does work.

tasks.title: Finish memory projections and governed context integration
steps: Add authorized memory.list/source/freshness/lineage projections for the desktop and context builder; do not invent claims when Serenity is unavailable.
Expose context selection as a governed durable job with exact brain revisions, scope, classification, freshness and disclosure/spend bounds.
Persist selected excerpts and provenance into immutable artifacts; use completion callbacks to finish owner/job state.
Implement promotion/retraction follow-up queue and corrected-source lineage so local metadata alone never claims the upstream write succeeded.
Keep unavailable upstream guarantees named, with read-only/advisory/enforced capabilities distinguished.
required_tests: Unauthorized brain is not queried; a revoked binding excludes future context but retained old context is unchanged.
Stale/missing provenance produces explicit prerequisite rather than fabricated memory.
Duplicate completion and restart preserve one selection/promotion lineage.
tasks.deliverable: Complete local memory read/projection and governed job contracts.

tasks.title: Implement the missing qualified Serenity service seam
steps: Begin with PROTOCOL.md and current capability report: all actual operations currently refuse and no physical request is made.

Qualify a public pinned service/read facade against the frozen local memory schemas. Implement only the operations whose actual upstream guarantees meet freshness, scope, bounded cost and disclosure requirements.
Translate read/context results into staged artifacts with provenance and pinned brain/index revisions; keep unsupported writes disabled with exact gaps.

For writer mode require one writer owner, stable command IDs, lookup/reconciliation and actual aggregate cost enforcement; implementing these upstream is an external prerequisite, not permission to edit another repository.
Record reproducible protocol-fixture evidence and required real-service qualification; do not relabel the current capability-only refusal adapter as working memory.
required_tests: Qualified reads issue bounded requests and return real claims/provenance; unauthorized destination issues zero calls.
Timeout/lost write ack remains unknown with no replay; unavailable required guarantee stays disabled.
Backup/export/freshness behavior is exercised against the pinned service before writer mode is advertised.
tasks.deliverable: A functioning qualified Serenity adapter or a precise upstream blocker per required capability.

tasks.title: Complete memory lifecycle against the qualified adapter
steps: Connect selection/recall/curation/promotion/retraction jobs to the real adapter modes and record normalized result artifacts.
Reconcile unknown memory writes by stable command identity and propagate corrections to derived/promoted claims without overwriting provenance.
Return actionable setup prerequisites if the installation's personal/org/worker brain has no qualified binding.
Integrate actual selected memory into hosted contexts while preserving current revocation and classification checks.
required_tests: A scoped turn recalls real selected claims with source refs and later audit reads exact old context.
Correction/retraction survives restart and never leaves a promoted claim falsely current.
Hard-bound mode refuses advisory/unsupported provider profiles.
tasks.deliverable: End-to-end usable memory, gated on explicit upstream capability evidence.

tasks.title: Add safe storage snapshot and offline restore mechanics
steps: Implement the narrow backup inventory/restore capability frozen in P00; expose migrations/schema checks through a typed capability, not arbitrary domain SQL access.
Validate an imported SQLite image and schema versions in staging before replacing the live file; checkpoint/close writers and prevent WAL mixing.
Provide crash-safe replacement/rollback markers and ownership/generation fencing for entrypoint/controller use while domain services are closed.
Support merge of the typed monotonic recovery overlay through owner migrations/ports after reopen; storage must not invent domain reconciliation.
Restore remains paused and cannot reopen the public mutation surface until verification/overlay completion.
required_tests: Crash at each staged-image/rename/reopen boundary yields a recoverable old or new database, never a mixed WAL.
Wrong installation/schema/image digest refuses before replacement.
Reopened database has a newer generation and exactly one writer.
tasks.deliverable: Narrow real database rewind primitive and recovery journal.

tasks.title: Support portable encrypted backup custody and blob restore
steps: Implement typed encrypted blob inventory/import and backup key-transfer mechanics fixed by P00 without exposing raw keys in manifests/API results.
Backups must be recoverable in a clean destination using explicit secure key provisioning; current opaque references to a different secret store are insufficient.
Verify every imported artifact digest and encrypt under the destination custody policy; retain restricted permissions and symlink defenses.
Keep failed restore staging isolated and cleanable without touching live user data.

Reproduce the platform failures from CI run 35473210732 on Linux and macOS: TestListenPrivateRefusesSymlinkedRunDirectory accepted a symlinked directory on both; TestBlobTamperedObjectFailsPublishOverExisting accepted tampered content on macOS. Establish the cause with filesystem fixtures before fixing implementation or fixture assumptions; preserve the rejection contracts.
required_tests: Backup key provisioned to a clean destination opens the bundle; missing key returns prerequisite_missing.
Corrupt/truncated artifact, symlinked destination or wrong installation cannot replace live blobs.
Secrets stay absent from ordinary logs, manifests and exported configuration.
TestListenPrivateRefusesSymlinkedRunDirectory and TestBlobTamperedObjectFailsPublishOverExisting pass on Linux and macOS without skips or weakened error assertions.
tasks.deliverable: Blob/key capabilities required for an actual portable restore.

tasks.title: Build complete backup bundles and monotonic recovery overlays
steps: Replace empty manifest lists with actual schema versions, encrypted artifact bytes/pins, brain exports/revisions, adapter profiles and retained obligations, all from narrow owner ports.
Capture a consistent paused/quiesced snapshot; required unavailable brain/blob capability must block a complete backup rather than yield success.

Include current credential/grant revocations, dispatch claims, provider keys, unknown effects/costs and cancellations in the authenticated monotonic overlay with enough records to merge, not just a summary digest.
Validate source binding/version/key prerequisites and stage a controller-readable restore work item; expose verification and progress through installation.job.get.
Record completion only after actual database/blob rewind and overlay merge. Never auto-resume.
required_tests: Back up real artifact and domain state, restore elsewhere, read identical bytes and find the same accepted task/history.
A post-backup revocation and unknown write remain effective after restore.
Missing brain export or referenced blob blocks complete backup; partial backup cannot be advertised as complete.
tasks.deliverable: Complete recoverable backups and explicit paused restore protocol.

tasks.title: Coordinate real restore outside the running database
steps: Implement an exclusive restore handoff that quiesces work, drains/records in-flight effects, closes admission and hands the sealed work item to entrypoint storage lifecycle code.
Do not run database replacement as an ordinary JobRunner that retains a live application/database handle.
Journal pre/post swap phases and merge monotonic owner evidence on reopen, then record installation/execution job result under the new generation.
Preserve unknown external effects and paused state across failure, restart and cancellation.
required_tests: Actual database state changes to the selected backup while newer revocations/unknown liabilities survive.
Crash during swap/overlay merge resumes paused and does not dispatch a provider call.
No old-generation controller/worker can commit after reopen.
tasks.deliverable: Exclusive controller restore coordination.

tasks.title: Wire restore lifecycle and recovery startup
steps: Implement startup detection of pending restore markers before normal assembly and listener admission.
Close old application/server/database in order, invoke narrow validated restore capability, reassemble owners and merge overlays, then expose paused status.
Attach restore coordinator through an explicit lifecycle seam; keep work/secret access out of ordinary client processes.
Provide machine-readable recoverable failure and exact resume prerequisites.
required_tests: A subprocess restore followed by a new process reads restored real state and retains post-backup revocation.
Restart during every restore phase never serves a partially restored writable installation.
Explicit resume is required and rechecks outstanding obligations.
tasks.deliverable: Production restore/restart lifecycle.

tasks.title: Expose complete receipts, event tails and audit projections
steps: Add a stable resumable event-tail cursor even on a drained page; bind it to principal/scope/filter/retention semantics.
Project turn/proposal/task/run/effect/verification linkage from committed evidence, including waiting and unknown dispositions, never from worker claims.
Provide retained command/result and job completion links for clients to resolve lost acknowledgements and later outcomes.
Preserve filter authorization, cursor expiry and no-secret output across new projections.
required_tests: A client drains events, restarts, then resumes without missing or endlessly rereading events.
Foreign/revoked scope cannot use an earlier cursor; expired cursor returns the named recovery path.
Receipt for an accepted effect remains pending until authoritative confirmation and never implies verified task success.
tasks.deliverable: Usable event streaming and truthful end-to-end evidence.

tasks.title: Close review lifecycle for live worker proposals
steps: Exercise exact reviews created by real hosted proposals, retaining proposer, immutable action digest, account/destination and content artifacts.
Provide readable reason/title plus pending/resolved review links for waiting turns; current eligibility and human-required policy remain authoritative.
Version/revoke/expire reviews and wake the corresponding turn only after the decision is committed; stale or denied reviews cannot trigger dispatch.
Keep delegated reviewer bounds independent of model text and preserve task/effect uncertainty when an operator cancels.
required_tests: Human approves one exact live proposal and only that action runs; changed content/head/account refuses.
Agent claiming approved_by_human cannot decide a human-required review.
Expired/revoked/duplicate decision produces no extra action or reply.
tasks.deliverable: Live review completion/wake integration.

Require pinned evidence identity, verifier versions, freshness and unchanged dependency closure; model reports and stale tests are not qualification.
Keep qualification below the configured ceiling and preserve human-required classes.
Expose why a capability was earned, lost or needs requalification for the desktop.

Relevant version change or incident invalidates qualification before the next effect admission.
Worker assertions/self-qualification and an unrelated dependency change behave according to the existing Z19 acceptance cases.

tasks.title: Complete the restore handoff: candidate staging and owner overlay merge
tasks.owner: internal/installation + internal/effects + internal/identity + internal/memory + internal/controller + cmd/zatiti (coordinated restore completion)
steps: Extend the frozen contract via tools/specgen/model.py (never hand-edit operations.json): add _effects.restore.merge, _identity.restore.merge and _memory.restore.merge (internal mutations, owners effects/identity/memory, callers: ["controller"]) that each fold their slice of a decoded RecoveryOverlay's obligations into their own tables monotonically; add _identity.revocations (internal query, owner identity, callers: ["installation"]) reporting current credential/grant revocation state; and add _installation.restore.overlay (internal query, owner installation, callers: ["controller"]) returning the published recovery-overlay artifact reference already recorded against a restore job. Regenerate assignments/fixtures and run python3 tools/specgen/render.py --check before any downstream step starts.

internal/identity: implement _identity.revocations, and implement _identity.restore.merge to re-apply (never lift) named credential/grant revocations monotonically -- never resurrecting a revocation newer than the overlay's own capture point, and idempotent under a repeated call with the same restore job's obligations.

internal/effects: implement _effects.restore.merge folding claimed_effect/unknown_effect obligations back into effects' own tables -- never resurrecting a completed dispatch, never resending a consumed one, idempotent under replay.
internal/memory: implement _memory.restore.merge folding memory_write obligations back into memory's own tables, idempotent under replay.

internal/installation: (a) call the new _identity.revocations peer op from snapshotObligations/prepareBackup/prepareRestore and add revoked_credential/revoked_grant to manifestObligation.Kind, so backup manifests and restore overlays actually carry revocations -- this is the exact gap internal/installation/restore_test.go's TestRestoreOverlayPreservesPostBackupUnknownEffectAcrossRewind doc comment names as currently unexercisable; (b) implement _installation.restore.overlay by promoting the overlay artifact reference finishRestore already writes into the local jobRow's Requirements to a typed field the new query can read directly; (c) export ResolveBackupCandidate and OpenRecoveryOverlay, thin wrappers taking no contract.Unit (pure SecretStore/BlobStore IO, mirroring how Perform already runs outside any transaction) around the existing unexported readPublished/decodeArtifact/resolveBackupKey/openBackupBundle/openRecoveryOverlay pipeline, so no caller outside this package ever reimplements the bundle's AEAD framing.

internal/controller: (a) extend RestoreLifecycle.StageCandidate to accept the restore job's original input (json.RawMessage) -- exactly what restoreClaim already captures via _execution.job.claim into e.JobInput today and currently discards; (b) add an OverlayArtifact field to the journal entry, populated in restoreClaim via the new _installation.restore.overlay call in the same pre-swap window as the existing _execution.job.claim call, so it survives a crash between claim and swap exactly as e.JobID/e.JobInput already do; (c) extend RestoreLifecycle.MergeOverlay to accept that overlay artifact reference; (d) thread both through performSwap's and mergeAndResume's existing call sites.

cmd/zatiti: (a) give restoreLifecycle real fields -- the already-available contract.SecretStore/contract.BlobStore, plus direct contract.Module references to the constructed effects/identity/memory services, selected from modules()'s returned slice at assembly exactly as buildJobRunners already selects contract.LocalJobRunner implementers; (b) StageCandidate decodes the backup artifact reference from the passed job input, calls installation.ResolveBackupCandidate directly and stages the result under dir; (c) MergeOverlay calls installation.OpenRecoveryOverlay with the passed overlay reference, buckets the decoded obligations by Owner, and for each bucket calls that owner Module's Handle(ctx, u, Invocation{Operation: "_owner.restore.merge", ...}) directly -- never through Application/Ports, because no live Application exists for the freshly reopened database until reassembleAfterRestoreHandoff runs later in this same process (Application.Internal itself is provably unusable here: this lifetime's own Application was built over the database handle CommitRestore already closed). Each new merge handler independently re-verifies unit.Actor() names the controller's own service principal before writing, since this call path bypasses Application.Internal's centralized caller check; (d) delete errNoCandidateLookup/errNoOwnerMerge and their fail-closed stubs.

Note for the integration owner: this card is deliberately multi-root because the gap it closes is genuinely cross-cutting, unlike P31/P32/P33's single-owner shape. It may be split into per-owner sub-cards sequenced exactly as steps 1-7 above (contract freeze, then identity, then effects, then memory, then installation, then controller, then cmd/zatiti) if isolated single-integration-owner execution is preferred; depends_on and write_roots here describe the whole, not a claim that one worktree must do it all at once.
required_tests: A real installation.backup followed by domain mutation (a newly accepted task, a new effect dispatch, one credential revocation and one grant revocation) followed by installation.restore to the earlier backup drives an actual controller swap; the resumed installation reads the backed-up task/effect state but the post-backup credential and grant remain revoked -- the exact behavior TestRestoreOverlayPreservesPostBackupUnknownEffectAcrossRewind's doc comment names as currently unexercisable.

Killing the process between a successful StageCandidate/CommitRestore and a completed MergeOverlay, then restarting, resumes from the journaled phase and finishes without re-decrypting the backup bundle or double-applying any merged obligation; repeating MergeOverlay against an already-merged state asserts no duplicate effect/revocation/memory rows.

Calling _effects.restore.merge, _identity.restore.merge or _memory.restore.merge with a non-controller actor is refused; StageCandidate and MergeOverlay's cmd/zatiti implementations are exercised against a real published, encrypted backup bundle and a real sealed overlay artifact, never a fake or an in-memory shortcut.

Backup and restore of an installation with zero pending obligations still succeeds (nothing to merge is not an error), and _identity.revocations reports zero revocations when the installation was bootstrapped and never restricted.
tasks.deliverable: A backup/restore protocol that completes end-to-end in production: RestoreLifecycle.StageCandidate and MergeOverlay perform real work instead of failing closed with prerequisite_missing.
